= Taurus Test Fixtures
:toc:
:toclevels: 3

== Overview

Comprehensive XML test fixtures from multiple sources for validating Taurus parser correctness, DOM operations, XPath evaluation, and namespace handling.

**Total Fixtures**: 100+ files across 4 sources +
**Coverage**: Basic XML, Namespaces, DOM operations, Real-world documents, Edge cases +
**Purpose**: Production-ready validation against industry-standard parsers

[[libxml2-fixtures]]
== libxml2 Test Fixtures

**Location**: `test/fixtures/libxml2/` +
**Source**: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2 +
**Documentation**: link:libxml2/README.adoc[libxml2/README.adoc] ✅

=== Categories (107 files)

[horizontal]
Namespace Tests:: 8 files (`ns`, `ns2`-`ns7`, `nsclean.xml`)
Attribute Tests:: 12 files (`att1`-`att11`, `attrib.xml`)
Entity Tests:: 16 files (`ent1`-`ent13`, `ent_*.xml`)
CDATA Tests:: 7 files (`cdata`, `cdata2`, `cdata-*-UTF-8.xml`, etc.)
Comment Tests:: 7 files (`comment.xml`-`comment6.xml`, `badcomment.xml`)
Processing Instructions:: 2 files (`pi.xml`, `pi2.xml`)
DTD Tests:: 15 files (`dtd1`-`dtd13`, `intsubset.xml`, `intsubset2.xml`)
Encoding Tests:: 5 files (`isolat1`-`isolat3`, `iso-8859-5.xml`, `utf8bom.xml`)
WebDAV Documents:: 18 files (`dav1`-`dav13`, `dav15`-`dav19`)
Diagram Documents:: 2 files (`dia1`, `dia2`)
Default Attributes:: 3 files (`def-xml-attr.xml`, `defattr.xml`, `defattr2.xml`)
Edge Cases:: 3 files (`bigname.xml`, `bigname2.xml`, `eve.xml`)
Real Documents:: 9 files (`svg1`, `rdf1`, `xhtml1`, `slashdot.xml`, etc.)

=== Key Test Scenarios

[cols="2,3,3",options="header"]
|===
|Fixture |DOM Tests |XPath Tests

|`ns`
|Element name, namespace prefix/URI, text content
|`//foo:a`, `//foo:a/text()`, `namespace::foo`

|`ns2`-`ns7`
|Multiple namespaces, inheritance, override
|Namespace-aware queries across prefixes

|`svg1` (21KB)
|SVG elements, attributes (width, height), navigation
|`//svg:rect`, `//svg:path/@d`, `count(//svg:*)`

|`rdf1`
|RDF metadata, `rdf:Description` elements
|`//rdf:Description`, `//dc:title/text()`

|`xhtml1`
|XHTML structure, `<head>`, `<body>`, `<p>` elements
|`//xhtml:title`, `//xhtml:a/@href`

|`att1`-`att11`
|Attribute access, iteration, normalization
|`//@id`, `//@class`

|`cdata`
|CDATA content with `<`, `>`, `&` preserved
|Text extraction from CDATA sections

|`ent1`-`ent4`
|Entity expansion (`&lt;` → `<`), numeric refs
|Text content after entity resolution
|===

[[pugixml-fixtures]]
== pugixml Test Fixtures

**Location**: `test/fixtures/pugixml/` +
**Source**: https://github.com/zeux/pugixml +
**Documentation**: link:pugixml/README.adoc[pugixml/README.adoc] ✅

=== Files (5 total)

[horizontal]
`small.xml`:: Minimal XML (`<node/>`), 7 bytes
`multiline.xml`:: Multiple self-closing elements, 30 bytes
`empty.xml`:: Empty file (error handling test), 0 bytes
`large.xml`:: Deep nesting stress test (1000+ elements), 68KB
`truncation.xml`:: Incomplete document (error recovery), 474 bytes

=== Test Scenarios

**DOM Validation**:
- Parse `small.xml` → verify single self-closing element
- Parse `multiline.xml` → verify 3 elements with whitespace
- Parse `empty.xml` → expect error, validate error message
- Parse `large.xml` → stress test (1000+ nested elements, 68KB)
- Parse `truncation.xml` → expect parse failure with line/column

**Performance Tests**:
- Parse time for `large.xml`
- Memory usage during `large.xml` parsing
- Deep recursion handling (stack depth)

== Usage Guide

=== Loading Fixtures in Tests

[source,c]
----
// C API - Load and parse fixture
const char* xml = load_fixture("test/fixtures/libxml2/ns");
TaurusDocument doc = taurus_parse_string(xml, strlen(xml), NULL);

// Or load directly as document
TaurusDocument doc = load_fixture_doc("test/fixtures/libxml2/svg1");
----

[source,cpp]
----
// C++ API (Google Test)
class MyTest : public XPathTestBase {
protected:
    void SetUp() override {
        load_fixture("libxml2/rdf1"); // Relative to fixtures dir
    }
};
----

=== CLI Commands

[source,bash]
----
# Parse and validate
taurus parse test/fixtures/libxml2/ns
taurus parse test/fixtures/pugixml/large.xml

# XPath queries
taurus xpath test/fixtures/libxml2/svg1 "//svg:rect"
taurus xpath test/fixtures/libxml2/rdf1 "//rdf:Description"

# Format output
taurus format --indent 4 test/fixtures/libxml2/ns2

# Performance testing
time taurus parse test/fixtures/pugixml/large.xml
time taurus xpath test/fixtures/large.xml "//node"
----

== Test Execution

=== Running Tests

[source,bash]
----
# Build tests
cmake -B build -S . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build

# Run all tests
cd build && ctest

# Run specific test suite
./build/test_xpath_functions_string
./build/test_libxml2_fixtures

# Run with valgrind (memory leak check)
valgrind --leak-check=full ./build/test_libxml2_fixtures
----

== Fixture Quality Standards

All fixtures in this directory meet these quality standards:

1. **Well-Formed XML**: All valid fixtures parse correctly
2. **Documented Purpose**: Each fixture has clear use case
3. **Test Scenarios**: Documented DOM/XPath test expectations
4. **Attribution**: Proper license & copyright attribution
5. **Validation**: Tested against Taurus, libxml2, pugixml

== Contributing New Fixtures

### Adding External Fixtures

1. Create subdirectory: `test/fixtures/{source}/`
2. Copy relevant files
3. Create `README.adoc` with:
   - Source attribution
   - License information
   - File descriptions
   - Test scenarios
4. Update this index
5. Add tests that use fixtures

### Creating Custom Fixtures

1. Place in `test/fixtures/` (root) or appropriate subdirectory
2. Document in this README
3. Add test cases
4. Ensure proper licensing (MIT for Taurus files)
